starting.task: Compete under the public victory rules. Coaching guides preferences. Return picks in priority order. Each pick has a choice index and an explicit repeat count (1–3). At each boundary the first currently legal pick may execute, until its repetitions expire. Picks can wait for eligibility, expire at the next checkpoint and never generate substitute actions. Interest in a position does not require repeating movement. Time units are 1/3000 second.
